name: fmcsa-hos-builder
description: HOS-compliant truck route planner and FMCSA daily log sheet generator

scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:api && pnpm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && python3.13 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --quiet --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install --quiet -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate --noinput
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta.bold,cyan.bold --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.start: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta.bold,cyan.bold "pnpm run start:api" "pnpm run start:web"
